Hi Marta —

Quick scheduling note: the EU shifts to CEST (UTC+2) on Sun Mar 29 — so when you say Tue Mar 30, 10:00 CET, the correct local label after the cutover is 10:00 CEST. That changes the UTC offset and therefore the converted times for PT / PDT. To avoid anyone joining at the wrong hour, here are the exact equivalencies for Tue Mar 30 (post-DST):

- 10:00 CEST (Brussels/Warsaw) = 01:00 PDT (US Pacific) / 04:00 EDT (US East)
- 17:00 SGT (Singapore) = 11:00 CEST

So the two options you proposed become (UTC-aware):
- Tue Mar 30, 10:00 CEST — which is very late for Pacific (01:00)
- Tue Mar 30, 17:00 SGT — which maps to Tue 11:00 CEST (a much better global overlap)

Given Sergio and I are coordinating with US SEs who are on Pacific time, the 10:00 CEST slot looks rough for them. Two options from Redwood:

1) Run a single session at Tue Mar 30, 11:00 CEST / 03:00 PDT to accommodate APAC and EU — (we know 03:00 PDT is still early but doable if someone covers US later)
2) Move to Wed Mar 31, 09:00 CEST / Tue 00:00 PDT so our US team can join without late-night travel conflicts (Laura flagged travel on Tue night)

I attached a calendar invite stub (redwood-demo-invite.ics) for the Wed Mar 31 slot and a draft mutual action plan we can update once you confirm. If you prefer, we can do two shorter region-specific sessions instead of one global run.

Proposed next step: confirm whether Tom can do Tue 11:00 CEST (17:00 SGT) or if Wed 09:00 CEST is preferable.

—Camila
